context: Request: M&A deals where the firm negotiated a fraud carve-out to the indemnity cap (indemnity playbook). Rubric: 26 matters (incl. 1001-00003/4/5/7, 1003-00003/4, 1006-00006/7/8, 1008-00008, 1037-00006, 1041-00003, 1046-00001 ...), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Reads three agreements of the two matters at the top of the listing, plus one store-wide files-with-matches grep for broad terms whose file list spans several matters (labelled by the store-wide search).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of four agreements or letters from four matters in the grep list.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads later sections of five agreements at offsets, looking for the indemnity terms.
Writes three matters as precedents and one as a counterexample; dismisses another.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its only keyword search was one broad grep whose file list reached a few matters; most qualifying matters never surfaced, and it named one matter outside the set.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only store-wide search was one grep for very broad terms whose file list reached only a few of the matters it needed; it never searched or scanned agreement text for the clause, so most never surfaced.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: Of the matters in its grep list it opened four and left several others it needed unopened.
It read the indemnity sections of two matters it needed and judged them not qualifying, presenting one as a counterexample (evidence seen at [14]-[30]).
It asserted a draft agreement from a matter outside the set as a qualifying precedent.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing

other_errors.why: It asserted a draft agreement from a matter outside the set as a qualifying precedent.

runs.failure_point: Its greps reached only some qualifying matters and it never scanned agreement text; of the ones it opened it kept only two whose emails stated the clause.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its searches were grep-tool searches whose hits came from a capped file list and from emails; it never scanned agreement text for the clause, so most of the matters it needed never surfaced.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: Of the matters in its first grep list it opened four and left several others it needed unopened.
It had opened three matters it needed (the opening of one agreement, emails of two others) but did not read far enough to find the clause and left them out.

divergence: All three runs failed at their store-wide search (search-miss): T0 and T2 relied on one or two grep-tool searches whose capped or email-only hits reached a few of the 26 qualifying matters; T1's only store-wide grep used a single-extension glob and returned nothing. All then judged a handful of matters; T0 and T1 also asserted a matter outside the set.
